title: Fosters Needed
intro: Fargo needs a new foster home. Tap the button to email us and raise your hand.

dogs.name: Fargo
dogs.bio: Fargo is an energetic, smart, affectionate girl who loves people, dog friends, toys and learning tricks for treats. She's crate trained, still working on housebreaking and settling, and would do best with structure in a home without cats, children, or anxious or older dogs.
